output.summary: The claim can be appealed by following the retroactive‑authorization playbook for inpatient surgery. Prior MRI and sleep‑study precedents do not apply.

items.text: File a retroactive authorization request for the inpatient surgery.
Attach the discharge summary as required by the prior‑authorization clause.
Submit the appeal within the appeal window specified in the policy.

The MRI referral precedent (F-MRI-REFERRAL) does not apply because this claim is for inpatient surgery, not an MRI, and the governing clause is C-2026-MRI-PREAUTH, which is unrelated to C-2026-INPATIENT-PREAUTH.
The sleep‑study retroactive‑auth precedent (F-SLEEP-RETRO) is irrelevant; it concerns sleep‑study services under C-2026-SLEEP-STUDY-PREAUTH, whereas this claim involves inpatient surgery.
